name: Hindustan Hotel Sukrut
why_it_matters: Shirdi's pilgrim-thali institution on Sansthan Lane, 200m from the Samadhi Mandir — Maharashtrian satvik thali (no onion-garlic by default), bhakri + pithla + zunka + dal + rice + sweet. Run by the Sukrut family since the early 90s.
insider_tip: Lunch queue starts 12pm; arrive 11.30 or after 2.30pm. Shrikhand changes daily — saffron Mon-Wed, mango Apr-Jun. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Sansthan Lane, near Samadhi Mandir, Shirdi 423109

name: Hotel Sai Vihar
why_it_matters: Pimpalwadi Road pure-veg pilgrim restaurant 500m from Sai Sansthan main gate — Maharashtrian + Punjabi thali combo for the multi-state pilgrim base. In-house parking, AC dining.
insider_tip: Pre-darshan breakfast 7-9am quietest. Thursday Sai-Baba aarti days lunch peak 1-3pm. Maharashtrian thali ₹220 vs Punjabi thali ₹280 — the Maharashtrian is the local default. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: Pimpalwadi Road, near Sai Sansthan, Shirdi 423109

name: Annapurna Pure Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: Station Road pure-veg multi-cuisine pilgrim default 800m from Sai Sansthan — unlimited Maharashtrian thali + South-Indian tiffin (idli-dosa-vada) for the railway-arriving pilgrim base.
insider_tip: South-Indian tiffin breakfast 6-10am is the railway-passenger window; thali kicks in 11.30am-3.30pm. Free filter-coffee refill with thali. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Shirdi Station Road, near Shirdi Railway Station, Shirdi 423109

name: Hotel Aroma
why_it_matters: Shirdi Junction-area pure-veg restaurant catering to bus-arriving pilgrim coaches — Maharashtrian + Mughlai (veg paneer-based) thali combo + AC dining + in-house parking.
insider_tip: Bus-coach lunch rush 12.30-2.30pm fills the hall — table-wait can hit 30 min on Thursdays + Ramnavami. Pre-9am quietest. Cards + UPI.

name: Hotel Shrimant
why_it_matters: Nagar-Manmad highway non-veg dining 1.5km from Sai Sansthan — the only mid-range non-veg option in Shirdi (the Sansthan-lane area is pure-veg-only by local tradition). Marathwada-style mutton sukka + bhakri + solkadhi.
insider_tip: Most pilgrims eat veg in temple-side restaurants; non-veg dining requires a 5-min auto-ride to the highway. Sunday lunch 1-3pm fills with off-circuit visitors; book +91-2423-258555. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: Nagar-Manmad Highway, near Shirdi Airport, Shirdi 423109

name: Sai Prasadalaya (Sansthan Bhojanalay)
why_it_matters: The Sansthan-run pilgrim canteen — 5,000-seater mega-dining hall built 2009 next to the Samadhi Mandir, feeding up to 40,000 pilgrims a day during peak. Token-system mahaprasad thali at ₹50 (varan-bhaat + 2 vegetables + chapati + dal + shira), the only government-subsidised dining of its scale in any Indian pilgrim town.
insider_tip: Buy token at the counter near the gate (₹50, valid for one meal). Lunch service 11am-3pm; dinner 6.30-9.30pm. Token queue heaviest Thursdays + festival days. Cards + UPI for token purchase; eating is free-flow once tokened.
signature_address: Sai Baba Sansthan Trust, Prasadalaya building, Shirdi 423109
